title: The SDK now tells you which models exist—and when an image request did not become an image
summary:
A practical day for builders: reliable SDK model lists, long-running MCP requests, and one more community image app in the garden.

SDK model discovery now calls the documented `/models` endpoint and returns the expected array, while image URL downloads reject non-2xx responses through the existing error parser instead of quietly handing callers an error page shaped like an image.

Authenticated MCP requests no longer hit a generic 30-second abort timer. Long-running work can finish, and callers still retain explicit cancellation through native AbortSignal support.

IMADreamer was added to the Pollinations app directory, giving people another free, API-powered route from a text prompt to generated images.

highlights.title: IMADreamer joins the garden
highlights.text: A free, Pollinations-powered image generator for turning prompts into pixels. [Try it](https://fastnow.github.io/imadreamer)

highlights.title: Models, now in a proper row
highlights.text: `Pollinations.models()` now reliably returns the available model array, so SDK apps can discover what the API has on offer. [SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk)

highlights.title: Let MCP requests breathe
highlights.text: Authenticated MCP requests can now run past 30 seconds when the job actually needs the time. [MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-server)
